eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are well-designed discriminators. All three test structured patterns that the documentation-generator skill explicitly mandates (persona/audience tables from persona-mapping, RICE/ICE priority scoring from prioritization, quickstart templates with learning objectives from user-journey-design). The without_skill run predictably fails all three — the executor produced technically solid but structurally minimal documentation with no audience segmentation, no priority ranking, and no learning-objective scaffolding. Evals look solid.
